tagline: A leading international owner of containerships
hero_kpi_rationale: The number of transportable containers (TEU) is the primary revenue driver in maritime shipping, directly reflecting operational capacity and competitive positioning of Costamare.

kpis.name: Fleet Capacity (in containers)
kpis.explanation: Total number of twenty-foot equivalent unit (TEU) containers the fleet can transport.
kpis.description: The fleet comprises vessels of various sizes, with a trend toward optimization toward larger and more efficient units.
kpis.signal: Organic fleet growth through targeted acquisitions.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Annual revenues generated from ship leasing contracts.
kpis.description: Revenue primarily derives from long-term charter contracts, providing visibility.
kpis.signal: Recovery in global trade and sustained freight rates.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: High margins driven by rigorous cost management and fixed-rate contracts.
kpis.signal: Improvement in operational efficiency despite fuel costs.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending for acquisition or modernization of vessels.
kpis.description: Capex oriented toward larger units and low-emission vessels.
kpis.signal: Fleet renewal with more efficient ships.

kpis.name: Headcount
kpis.description: Operations are outsourced to specialized technical managers.
kpis.signal: Highly lean staffing model through operations outsourcing.

kpis.name: Long-term Charters (% of total)
kpis.explanation: Share of revenue from leasing contracts longer than 1 year.
kpis.description: Majority of charters are long-term, reducing exposure to spot market fluctuations.
